title: 周末活动

explanations.1: Demonstrative pronoun referring to the current weekend.
explanations.3: Indicates that the action is done jointly.
explanations.6: Time adverb indicating the first action in sequence.
explanations.7: Locative noun indicating position in front of the bookstore.
explanations.8: Structural particle linking adjective 'big' to noun 'square'.
explanations.9: Locative noun indicating position on the square.
explanations.10: Dynamic particle marking completion of entering the bookstore.
explanations.11: Numeral indicating the quantity of books bought.
explanations.12: Measure word for books, used after the numeral.
explanations.13: Adverb indicating an additional action (also drank coffee).
explanations.14: Negation adverb forming the alternative question 'drink or not'.
explanations.15: Modal verb expressing ability to row a boat.

translation: This weekend, my friend and I went to the bookstore together from home. We first took the subway, then walked. In front of the bookstore, there was a big square. There were many pigeons on the square. We entered the bookstore and bought two books. I bought a Chinese book, and my friend bought an English book. My friend asked me what book I bought, and I told him it was a Chinese book. There were many people in the bookstore. We also drank a cup of coffee next to the bookstore. The coffee was very tasty. My friend asked if I wanted another drink, and I said no. In the afternoon, we went to the park for a walk. There were not many people in the park, but there was a lake. We could row a boat, so we rented a small boat and rowed for half an hour. In the evening, we had dinner outside the park. Today we were all very happy.
